name: Julia
source:
A princess that was born from a concubine of the king of Veke.
Even though she is a princess, from the moment she was born she was treated badly and confined in a tower at the northern part of the castle.
A rumor spread through all the people in the castle that it was because the true queen hated her.
But Julia herself doesn't think that her life in the tower is unfortunate at all, she spends her days leisurely with her animal friends working on her sewing.
